d: A hybrid creature with a blue-purple mammalian body, featuring a large, thick mane of deep crimson hair and a smaller tuft of platinum white hair on the side of the head. The build is muscular and anthropomorphic, wearing an outfit consisting of brown wooden armor plating and a deep crimson waist cloth.
